gui.wmi.title: Way More Items
gui.wmi.no_recipes: No known recipes for this item.
gui.wmi.hud.title: Workshop Checklist
gui.wmi.no_permission: Operator permission or Creative mode required.
wmi.settings.title: Way More Items Settings
wmi.notes.title: Notes
wmi.notes.add_tip: Add an item (alone or with its crafting tree)
wmi.notes.add_item_tip: Add this item and quantity to the list (Enter)
wmi.notes.add_tree_tip: Add this item with its tree of ingredients
wmi.notes.branch_expand_tip: Show the ingredients of this item
wmi.notes.branch_collapse_tip: Hide the ingredients of this item
wmi.settings.tab.catalog.desc: The item panel next to the inventory: grid, order and search.
wmi.settings.tab.keys.desc: The same keys as in Controls. Click to change, right-click for the default key.
wmi.settings.autosave: Every change is applied and saved at once.
wmi.settings.recipe_viewer.desc: Window opened by the recipe and usage keys while JEI is installed.
wmi.settings.vanilla_book.desc: Green button of the inventory and crafting table.
wmi.settings.mod_in_tooltip.desc: Adds the mod name, in blue, at the bottom of each item tooltip.
wmi.settings.reset_all.desc: Restores every WMI setting, keys included. Notes and goals are kept.
wmi.settings.theme.desc: Click the name for the next theme, right-click for the previous one.
wmi.settings.custom_color.desc: The whole theme comes from this one color. Light colors give a light theme with dark text.
wmi.settings.render.desc: Smooth: crisp vector outlines. Pixels: Minecraft style.
wmi.settings.ui_scale.desc: Specific to WMI, independent from the game's GUI scale.
wmi.settings.panel_opacity.desc: Lower, the game shows more behind WMI.
wmi.settings.toolbar.desc: Where the WMI toolbar sits around the inventory.
wmi.settings.toolbar_labels.desc: Text next to the icons, when there is room.
wmi.settings.toolbar_labels.reason: Only for the toolbar on top.
wmi.settings.icon_size.desc: Size of each item in the grid.
wmi.settings.columns.desc: Auto: all the free space next to the inventory.
wmi.settings.rows.desc: Auto: the full height of the panel.
wmi.settings.catalog_tabs.desc: Row of tabs above the items (All, then one per mod).
wmi.settings.catalog_sort.desc: With a machine open, its items stay first.
wmi.settings.catalog_sort.name: By name
wmi.settings.item_names.desc: For display and search. The WMI interface keeps the game language.
wmi.settings.clear_search.desc: Otherwise the last search stays until the game is closed.
wmi.settings.center_left.desc: Time, day and biome next to the open inventory.
wmi.settings.widget_size.desc: Also adjustable with the handle in its corner.
wmi.settings.widget_position.desc: Drag the clock to move it; this button puts it back in place.
wmi.settings.sun_moon.desc: On the inventory clock and the clock while playing (not on the compact one).
wmi.settings.night_alert.desc: The time turns gold during the minute before monsters appear.
wmi.settings.notes_empty.desc: A small reminder stays when there is no note or goal.
wmi.settings.notes_depth.desc: In the inventory, click a branch to expand it.
wmi.settings.done_behavior.desc: What a line becomes once the inventory holds the wanted amount.
wmi.settings.clock_in_game.desc: Small fixed-size bar at the top center: time, day and biome.
wmi.settings.clock_mod.desc: Third line of the compact clock: the mod the biome comes from.
wmi.settings.corner_widget.desc: Time, day, biome and sun and moon lines, in a top corner of the screen.
wmi.settings.notes_hud.desc: Keep the Notes on screen with the inventory closed, under the clock.
wmi.settings.corner.reason: Clock and Notes both hidden while playing.
wmi.settings.hud_side.desc: Clock and Notes while playing: top left or top right corner.
wmi.settings.hud_opacity.desc: Of the clock and the Notes while playing.
wmi.settings.hide_f1.desc: The WMI HUD disappears with the game's.
wmi.settings.hide_debug.desc: Keeps the clock and the Notes off the F3 information.
wmi.settings.key_recipes.desc: In the inventory, the catalog or a recipe; in game, the held item.
wmi.settings.key_uses.desc: Recipes where the item is an ingredient.
wmi.settings.key_pin.desc: Pins the hovered item to the Notes.
wmi.settings.key_note.desc: Opens note input, even with the inventory closed.
wmi.settings.key_sort.desc: Sorts the inventory, or the chest under the cursor.
wmi.settings.key_quick.desc: Commands, a note or a Notes item in one window.
wmi.settings.controls.desc: All the keys of the game and the other mods.
wmi.settings.tab.appearance.desc: Theme, rendering, interface size and panel opacity.
wmi.settings.tab.inventory.desc: What appears around the open inventory: toolbar and clock.
wmi.settings.tab.widget.desc: What the clocks and the Notes show, in the inventory as while playing.
wmi.settings.tab.screen.desc: Everything that stays on screen while playing: clocks, Notes, placement and hiding.
wmi.settings.theme.custom_reason: Replaced by your color while Customize is on.
wmi.settings.customize.desc: Build the theme from a color of your choice.
wmi.settings.vanilla_warning.title: Minecraft theme (alpha)
wmi.settings.vanilla_warning.text: This theme is still in alpha. You will run into display and style problems: misaligned frames, unreadable text or mismatched buttons.
wmi.button.settings_tip: Way More Items settings (theme, grid, toolbar, widget)
wmi.button.viewer_jei_tip: Go back to the WMI recipe panel (JEI steps aside)
wmi.button.viewer_wmi_tip: Leave the right side to JEI (the WMI bar, Notes and widget stay)
wmi.sort.button_tip: Sort the bag (Shortcut: middle-click a slot or press B)
wmi.sort.order_tip: Change the sort order (Category / A-Z / Quantity)
wmi.bar.heal_tip: Restore health and hunger to full
wmi.bar.purge_tip: Remove items on the ground (64-block radius)
wmi.bar.clear_inventory_tip: Clear your whole inventory (cannot be undone; asks for confirmation)
wmi.confirm.clear_inventory: Your whole inventory will be deleted: items, armor, offhand and crafting grid. This cannot be undone.
wmi.bar.biomes_tip: Teleport to the nearest biome of a kind
wmi.bar.collapse_tip: Collapse the bar (keep time and weather)
wmi.sort.chest_tip: Sort the open chest (or middle-click inside the chest)
wmi.mode.tip:
Switch what a click on an item does:
• Mode: Give (left click: a stack, right click: one item)
• Mode: Recipe (left click: recipe, right click: uses)
wmi.search.tip: Search by name, @mod, #tag or %s (craftable from your inventory) (Double-click: highlight in chests • Right-click: clear)
wmi.recipe.add_to_notes_tip: Add the crafting tree to Notes
wmi.recipe.place_in_grid_tip: Places the ingredients from your inventory into the open grid
wmi.tree.amount_tip: Amount to craft: click to type it, or scroll
wmi.recipe.give_tip: Adds a stack to your inventory
wmi.cmd.capture_armed: [WMI] Capture armed: open an inventory, a chest or the creative inventory.
wmi.network.unavailable: This feature needs Way More Items on the server.
wmi.layout.err.not_object: The layout must be a JSON object.
wmi.layout.err.not_before: %1$s: "%2$s" is not computed before this element
wmi.biomes.title: Biomes
wmi.enchantments.title: Enchantments
wmi.extract.entropy.title: Entropy manipulation
wmi.extract.entropy.cool: Cooling mode, on the block in the world
wmi.extract.entropy.heat: Heating mode, on the block in the world
wmi.extract.transform.title: In-world transformation
wmi.extract.transform.fluid: Throw the items into a fluid (%s)
wmi.extract.transform.explosion: Drop the items together, then set off an explosion next to them
wmi.extract.crafting_unit.title: Crafting unit upgrade
wmi.extract.crafting_unit.note: Use the component on a placed crafting unit
wmi.extract.crafting_unit.undo: Sneak and use the upgraded block in hand to get the component back
wmi.extract.disassembly.title: Cell disassembly
wmi.extract.disassembly.note: Sneak and use the empty cell in hand
wmi.extract.cell_upgrade.title: Storage cell upgrade
wmi.extract.cell_upgrade.note: Combine them in the crafting grid: the previous component is given back
wmi.extract.ammo.title: Matter Cannon ammo
wmi.extract.facade.title: Facade
wmi.extract.facade.note: Four cable anchors around any block: 4 facades of that block
wmi.extract.add_upgrade.title: Adding an upgrade
wmi.extract.add_upgrade.note: Combine an upgradeable item with its upgrade cards in the crafting grid
wmi.extract.remove_upgrade.title: Removing an upgrade
wmi.extract.remove_upgrade.note: Place an upgraded item alone in the crafting grid: one upgrade card comes out
